note: Runtime authority per Flight command. Data, checked against the code by tests/test_authority.py; never shipped in a Flight. 'sites' lists every place in a Flight's code that reads a non-config environment value, writes or runs DDL on PostgreSQL, creates a MotherDuck database or schema, or starts another Flight; each site names the commands that execute it. A command's authority is the union of its sites. 'granted' is what its credentials allow today (no narrowing yet); 'enforced' names what actually limits it. Every command that can reach a site's module is either in its 'commands' or in its 'not_executed' with the reason (message sites execute for none).

preflight.granted: the owner's MotherDuck token (every database the owner can write); the PostgreSQL role in the DSN secret
preflight.enforced: the DDL runs only with CDC_CREATE_OBJECTS=1, and only for missing objects; the role's grants (docs/setup.md, the DBA script) limit it further

ingest.granted: the owner's MotherDuck token; the PostgreSQL role in the DSN secret
ingest.enforced: code only: the one PostgreSQL write is the heartbeat upsert; the role's grants on the heartbeat

apply.enforced: code only; no PostgreSQL secret is attached

backfill.granted: the owner's MotherDuck token; the PostgreSQL role in the DSN secret
backfill.enforced: code only: the heartbeat marker upsert and an append table's temporary snapshot slot; the self-trigger id is the runtime's, never config

compact.enforced: code only; no PostgreSQL secret is attached

table-action.enforced: owner-only (no RUN grants; scripts/deploy_dive.py --flights refuses a grant when the Dive is deployed); trigger targets are baked OWNER settings, not config

table-membership.granted: the owner's MotherDuck token; the PostgreSQL role in the secret OWNER.dsn_env names (the replication role by default)
table-membership.enforced: owner-only (no RUN grants); it only reads the PostgreSQL catalog and prints the DBA's ALTER PUBLICATION; the trigger target is a baked OWNER setting

quarantine.enforced: owner-only (no RUN grants); a typed confirmation of the unit

epoch.granted: the owner's MotherDuck token; the PostgreSQL role in the secret OWNER.dsn_env names
epoch.enforced: owner-only (no RUN grants); a typed confirmation; only this database's inactive pgoutput slots are dropped

delete-source.granted: the owner's MotherDuck token; the PostgreSQL role in the secret OWNER.dsn_env names
delete-source.enforced: owner-only (no RUN grants); a typed confirmation; it drops only objects its own preflight recorded as created

dive.enforced: the Flights are owner-only, so only the owner's Dive session can start them; other viewers see a read-only Dive (docs/dive.md)

deploy_dive.enforced: with --flights it refuses an action Flight that has a RUN grant to anyone else; a grant added later isn't detected

implicit_reads.libpq: PG* environment variables (none are set by the Flights; the DSN is passed explicitly)
implicit_reads.duckdb: motherduck_token / MOTHERDUCK_TOKEN, read by the md: connection itself

secret_slots.config: declared CDC_ config keys, read by a computed key (chain's typed readers, action inputs, blank_to_unset)
secret_slots.pg_dsn: the PostgreSQL DSN, from the variable CDC_DSN_ENV or OWNER.dsn_env names
